checks.label: repro

checks:
cd /testbed && python -c "
from astropy.modeling import models as m
from astropy.modeling.separable import separability_matrix
cm = m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)
print('flat compound:')
print(separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)))
print('nested compound:')
print(separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm))
"

cd /testbed && python -c "
import numpy as np
from astropy.modeling import models as m
from astropy.modeling.separable import separability_matrix
cm = m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)
res = separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm)
expected = np.array([[True, True, False, False],[True, True, False, False],[False, False, True, False],[False, False, False, True]])
assert np.array_equal(res, expected), ('nested compound wrong:\n', res)
assert np.array_equal(separability_matrix(cm), np.eye(2, dtype=bool))
assert np.array_equal(separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)), expected)
assert np.array_equal(separability_matrix(cm & m.Linear1D(1)), np.eye(4, dtype=bool))
assert np.array_equal(separability_matrix(cm & cm), np.eye(4, dtype=bool))
print('repro OK')
"

args.output_contract: A short summary of what was changed (file, line, before/after), not the full patch.
args.description: In /testbed/astropy/modeling/separable.py, inside the function `_cstack` (around line 219-247), there is a bug in the handling of the right operand when it is a precomputed separability matrix (ndarray) rather than a Model: the else-branch fills the bottom-right block with the constant 1, discarding the actual matrix. Change exactly this line (currently `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1`) to copy the right operand's matrix into that block instead: `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right`. Do not change anything else in the file — no reformatting, no other edits, no test files, no config files. The left-operand else branch is already correct and must stay as-is.
